_comment: Cadence rules. Touch every 14 days (alternating SMS/email), an offer every 30, personal check-in at 60 days silent, reactivation at 90, dead-lead campaign at 180. Silent = no reply and no deal. The SMS window is the RECIPIENT's local time (from the area code; a number whose zone is unclear must be inside the window everywhere it could be). Unapproved batches expire after action_ttl_hours. The inbox reads back inbox_lookback_days.
